verdict.rationale: Mem0's search API returns relevant memories ranked/reranked by semantic relevance in a single call (mem0-docs-7, mem0-docs-10, mem0-docs-31), which covers the 'relevant memories in one call' part of the story, but there is no documented feature for token-budget management or assembling a ready-to-paste prompt context block — retrieval returns raw memory objects, not a formatted, size-constrained context string. Missing for 10: explicit token-budget/context-window control, a 'prompt-ready' formatted output mode, and any documentation or example showing a single call producing an assembled context block rather than a list of memories.
